title: X Mob Core
name: x_mob_core
short_description: A smooth, lightweight mob framework that powers smart creatures, animal packs, and tactical combat without slowing down your server.
long_description:
**X Mob Core** is a pure developer API and next-generation mob framework for Luanti.

> **Important**: This package is an underlying engine library and does **not** include any mobs on its own. It is designed for mod developers and server creators to easily build high-performance creatures, wildlife, and boss encounters.

### Why Choose X Mob Core for Your Mobs?

- **Engineered for High-Density Multiplayer**: Traditional mob engines often struggle with scale—flooding the server with hundreds of thousands of redundant map queries, triggering heavy Lua garbage collection spikes, and causing tick stutter. X Mob Core uses intelligent corridor raycasts, node cache lookup tables, and coroutine-sliced pathfinding, delivering over **3x lower latency** and cutting map queries by over 98% under heavy stress.
- **Pack & Swarm Intelligence Out of the Box**: Create complex, lifelike group dynamics without writing custom math. Features native support for aquatic schooling (shoals), 3D aerial flocking (swarms), leader-follower squads with democratic successor election, and dynamic faction threat rallying.
- **Tactical Combat & Status Effects**: Built-in declarative melee and projectile combat with predictive intercept aiming, tactical kiting, health bars, directional hit particles, 3D visual status sleeves (envelops), and responsive fullscreen HUD vignettes with compound physics scaling.
- **Zero External Dependencies**: Completely self-contained with no required third-party libraries. All entity states, timers, and death cleanups are strictly guarded against memory leaks, orphan attachments, and desyncs.
- **Modern Developer Experience**: Fully annotated with comprehensive EmmyLua types for rich code completion and diagnostics in modern editors, accompanied by a complete 3,700+ line API reference manual.
